summary: @servicetitan/error-boundary preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/... at install time and then invokes it via execFileSync against math_init.js, a 727 KB single-line bundle shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated with a rotated string-array decoder (push/shift rotation) and hex-mangled identifiers, hiding its actual behavior from readers and from Node-based install-time scanners since execution occurs under a separately fetched alternate runtime. package.json advertises the package as "Implementation of React error boundary mechanism" with main pointing at a small React re-export, and the install-time Bun-runtime dropper is unrelated to that advertised purpose. Fetching a second runtime specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated sibling script on npm install is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape and causes attacker-controlled code to run automatically on any default `npm install` of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
